blocks.text: Maple Ridge Condos by Price Band: streets and boundaries

items.t: This page is a price-band filter over the whole City of Maple Ridge, not a neighbourhood: the band topic is condos under $800K anywhere in the city.

The planned condo core is Town Centre: the updated Town Centre Area Plan expanded its boundaries to include River Bend and supports higher-density, transit-oriented growth around Haney Transit Exchange and Port Haney Station.
The downtown cluster sits along the Lougheed Highway and Dewdney Trunk Road corridors around 224 Street and 227 Street, where the Town Centre plan concentrates multi-family designations.

blocks.text: Maple Ridge Condos by Price Band: the housing stock

items.t: Whether any specific building's units sit under $800K is a listing fact at the time, not a building fact, and is not stated for any building here.

blocks.text: Maple Ridge Condos by Price Band: rules that affect buyers

items.t: The most recent depreciation report must be attached to the Form B Information Certificate given to buyers.
Form B is the disclosure a buyer prices from: the Province's Form B page covers strata fees, amounts owing, levies and the attached budget, rules and depreciation report.
Rental-restriction bylaws have been unenforceable for long-term rentals since November 24, 2022, whatever an older building directory says; short-term rentals can still be restricted.
Transit-Oriented Area Designation Bylaw No. 8001-2024 covers the Haney Transit Exchange and Port Haney Station areas, which is the planning frame for new core buildings.

blocks.text: Maple Ridge Condos by Price Band: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Four Fraserview Village buildings are separate strata corporations sharing one village amenity building, so a unit's fees and votes sit with its own strata, not the village.

blocks.text: Maple Ridge Condos by Price Band: development and new projects

items.t: The Town Centre Area Plan update adopted November 25, 2025 is the active planning change for this band's core: it consolidates designations and supports higher-density, transit-oriented growth around Haney Transit Exchange and Port Haney Station.

The City reports over 150 rezoning applications and 450 building permits underway citywide, with density encouraged on the Lougheed Transit Corridor and in Town Centre — no project-by-project condo list for this band is stated here.

blocks.text: Maple Ridge Condos by Price Band: costs and taxes

items.t: PTT is the band's main closing tax: the Province's general rates and the first-time buyer thresholds in decide the bill, and the exemption is claimed by the buyer's legal professional on the PTT return.
Maple Ridge utility charges are billed mainly on the annual tax notice, with metered accounts billed quarterly from January 1, 2026 under seasonal rates.

blocks.text: Maple Ridge Condos by Price Band: getting around

items.t: Port Haney Station at 22300 River Road is the core's West Coast Express stop, on the weekday Waterfront to Mission City line.
Haney Place Exchange is the city's bus hub in the core, with the R3 Lougheed Highway RapidBus to Coquitlam Central Station.

blocks.text: Maple Ridge Condos by Price Band: risks and due diligence

items.t: Check flood status for river-edge buildings: on the Port Haney/River Road edge the verified flood construction level is 6.7 metres geodetic including freeboard, with a covenant on title and no habitable floor space below that level on affected lots.
The current floodplain framework is Floodplain Management Bylaw No. 8121-2026, which designates flood hazard and connected riverine areas across the city.
In an older building, the depreciation report's 30-year projection and the contingency reserve fund balance are the levy-risk check, and both must be in the Form B package.

faq.a: It tells you the money facts the listing omits. The Province requires the certificate to carry the unit's strata fees and amounts owing and to attach the rules, the current budget and the most recent depreciation report, so special levies, reserve funding and parking and storage allocation are checked there before subject removal, not after.
faq.q: What does the Form B tell me that the listing does not?

faq.a: On a five-year cycle, with no opt-out vote. Since July 1, 2024 every strata corporation with five or more lots must obtain a depreciation report every five years, the report projects maintenance and replacement over 30 years, and corporations with four or fewer lots are the only ones exempt — so a missing report on a larger Maple Ridge building is a red flag, not a normal gap.
faq.q: How current must a building's depreciation report be?

faq.a: Read them in the strata documents, in this order. Ask for the Form B first, because it states how parking and storage are allocated to the unit, then read the registered bylaws and rules attached to it for the pet bylaw; a directory summary or a listing remark is not the bylaw, and only the filed bylaw text governs what a buyer can keep or park.
faq.q: How do I check a building's pet and parking rules?

faq.a: Port Haney and Maple Meadows, both on the West Coast Express. TransLink runs the weekday commuter line between Waterfront in downtown Vancouver and Mission City with those two Maple Ridge stops, and Haney Place Exchange in the core carries the R3 RapidBus toward Coquitlam Central — the two anchors the Town Centre plan builds its density around.
faq.q: Which stations serve the downtown condo core?

faq.a: Where the attached stock sits: East Central held 120 condos & townhomes listings and West Central 78 in September 2026 — about seven in ten of the city's attached listings — and the live page's visible cards are labelled East Central and West Central; those are inventory counts for condos and townhomes combined, not a count of condos under the cap (SnapStats, September 2026)
faq.q: Where do Maple Ridge condos under $800K actually sit?

faq.a: The cap sits above the market's middle: the Maple Ridge condos & townhomes median sale price was $525,000 in September 2026 — $275,000 below the cap — though that median mixes townhomes with condos and swung from $640,000 in August 2026 on small sold counts, so treat it as context for where the cap sits, not as the price of a typical condo (SnapStats, September 2026)
faq.q: Does the $800K cap cover the typical Maple Ridge condo?

faq.a: The strata package (Form B, depreciation report, minutes, insurance certificate) under the provincial strata framework — strata disputes can go to the Civil Resolution Tribunal — plus, for a building at the Port Haney river edge, the floodplain check: flood construction level 6.7 m geodetic and a covenant on title for floodplain construction.
faq.q: What should I check before removing subjects on a Maple Ridge condo?
